protocol: Codex app-server JSON-RPC v2 candidate protocol

preflight.ordering_rule: Evaluate CodexRequestContext before forwarding turn/start to app-server.
preflight.direct_behavior: Forward the original turn/start with additive digest-bound routing context.
preflight.gate_behavior: Do not forward turn/start; return the exact candidates, reasons, provenance, and owner route to the user interaction surface.
preflight.block_behavior: Do not forward turn/start; return causal blocker residue.

effect_boundary.ordering_rule: Evaluate the proposed effect before returning an approval response.
effect_boundary.direct_behavior: Approve only when the engine directive and independent Codex permission policy both permit the exact effect.
effect_boundary.gate_behavior: Withhold approval and route the exact decision to its owner.
effect_boundary.block_behavior: Deny the request; interruption policy remains an adapter design concern.

continuation.bounded_completion_definition: One completed Codex turn plus all item and approval events attributed to that turn.
continuation.assessment_rule: Reconcile plan-bound proposals and interaction-bound proposals with mechanism-observed turn, item, and approval evidence, then evaluate continuation before starting another turn.

proposal_lanes.plan_bound: Project only digest-bound declared successor actions; exactly one verified safe proposal may qualify for direct.
proposal_lanes.interaction_bound: Normalize attributed agent, chat, or human proposals as candidate meaning; always gate until a human decision binds the exact proposal digest.

continuation.merge_rule: Any interaction-bound proposal, multiple surviving proposals, or unknown metadata gates; only one safe plan-bound proposal and no interaction-bound proposal may be direct.
continuation.direct_behavior: Start at most one next turn when exactly one admissible plan-bound proposal is explicitly reversible and non-consequential and no interaction-bound proposal survives.
continuation.gate_behavior: Start no successor turn and present the exact consequential, ambiguous, or interaction-bound choice with attribution and provenance.
continuation.complete_behavior: Start no successor turn and close the capability run.
continuation.block_behavior: Start no successor turn and preserve causal residue.

fail_closed_conditions: protocol version or selected schema projection drift
missing request, turn, item, effect, or decision identity
unknown effect, reversibility, owner route, or selected dependency
interaction-bound proposal without a human decision bound to its exact digest
agent prose presented as plan-bound or authoritative evidence
claim_limit: Candidate immutable interface shape derived after owner selection of the app-server wrapper boundary. It is not an accepted implementation binding and proves no live interception, enforcement, conformance, or effect authority.
